property_summary: Calling donate(amount) (when it does not revert) transfers exactly that amount out of the contract (so address(c).balance decreases by at least amount) and increments totalDonated equivalently observable via winnersPot() change bounds — encoded as: if donate succeeded then address(c).balance_after + amount <= address(c).balance_before and winnersPot_after <= winnersPot_before.
